pages.text: Place six matching altar blocks as a 3 by 2 rectangle, with no extra altar blocks touching the border. Use a carpet on top to form the altar. Empty-hand right-click shows stored power, capacity and regeneration.

Plant varied vegetation nearby to increase capacity. Repeating one plant gives diminishing returns. Grass blocks do not supply power capacity. The base altar regenerates eight power each second; let it charge before operating machines.

Distilleries, cauldrons and spinning wheels find a formed altar within 24 blocks on each axis. Skull, planted-pot, light and placed-item upgrades can improve the altar. Breaking an altar member dismantles the structure and returns the carpet.
